name: AI company job boards
measures: Open software engineering roles at 11 AI companies
about: These companies list open roles through public job board feeds. We count software engineering roles by job title, and do not store or publish the listings.
attribution: Counts derived from public job boards at OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, xAI, Cohere, Perplexity, Cursor, Cognition, Replit, Lovable and Factory.
limitations: Roles are matched by title, so some are missed or wrongly included, and titles differ between companies.
An open listing is not always an active hire, and one role can be listed in several locations.
Fast-growing, well-funded companies hire for many reasons, so this does not show how much of their code AI writes.
Job boards only show today, so history starts with our first count.
